plainText:
Masataka Azuma (Japanese: 我妻正崇 Azuma Masataka) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Azuma was born sometime on January 25, in , . He became a voice actor as an adult and mostly got minor roles. He voiced one of his best-known roles as Oreburgh City Gym Leader Roark, during . Azuma is currently affiliated with Max Mix, but apparently hasn't had any roles since 2009.
